hypotheses.hypothesis: Check whether the declared URL scheme permits a protected action after sign-out
hypotheses.priority_reason: The scheme is a documented external entry point that can receive controlled parameters
hypotheses.attacker_control: A benign link and its parameters, opened on a test device
hypotheses.attack_scenario: If the link handler uses those parameters for a protected action without checking the current account, a link sender could cause that action when the recipient opens it. Handler behavior is unverified.
hypotheses.possible_impact: A protected action could occur without the expected account authorization if the handler fails to recheck it
hypotheses.test_plan: Under a test account, record the authorized result; sign out and repeat the same benign link; then try a second test account with an object belonging to the first
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: The app rejects the action when signed out and under the second account
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Handler behavior, authorization checks, and repeatable test results
